name: Brandfolder
description: Deep integration between Drupal and the Brandfolder Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform: browse Brandfolder assets, create Drupal media on demand, and serve/transform images from the Brandfolder Smart CDN.
project_description:
This module integrates Drupal with the Brandfolder Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform.

 Features include:

 
 Media and Media Library support with live Brandfolder asset browser creating Drupal entities on demand 
 Entity Browser module support 
 Create as many custom media types for image-related assets as needed, configuring the way that each one integrates with Brandfolder 
 1-way (Brandfolder->Drupal) metadata sync 
 Native file support for Brandfolder-related files 
 Drupal image style support while serving images directly from Brandfolder CDN 
 Webhook listener to trigger Drupal events when Brandfolder assets are created/updated/deleted 
 
 ...with more features coming soon. Let us know any specific requests in the issue queue!

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 An active Brandfolder account with "Smart CDN" functionality enabled 
 The Brandfolder PHP SDK (should be automatically installed by Composer) 
 A supported Drupal and PHP version combination (see below)
